# gitea_user_actions_variable (Resource)

`gitea_user_actions_variable` manages a user-scoped Actions variable.

Import expects the resource ID in the form `variable_name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `value` (String) The user-scoped Actions variable value.
- `variable_name` (String) The user-scoped Actions variable name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The user-scoped Actions variable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
